title: An integer-valued a.e.-measurable function on a probability space has an integer median
statement: Let X be a measurable space and μ a probability measure on X. Let u : X → ℝ be μ-a.e.-measurable with u(x) ∈ ℤ for every x ∈ X. Then there is β ∈ ℤ with μ{x : β ≤ u(x)} ≥ 1/2 and μ{x : u(x) ≤ β} ≥ 1/2, where μ(A) denotes the real number μ.real A = (μ A).toReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (u : X → ℝ), IsProbabilityMeasure μ → AEMeasurable u μ → (∀ x, ∃ z : ℤ, u x = z) → ∃ β : ℤ, 1 / 2 ≤ μ.real {x | (β : ℝ) ≤ u x} ∧ 1 / 2 ≤ μ.real {x | u x ≤ (β : ℝ)}
